newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends sharply lower on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends sharply lower on dollar demand.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 4.60 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,085, coming under pressure from bank and corporate demand for U.S. currency, interbank dealers said.
They said three or four major banks and Colmotores, the local subsidiary of General Motors Corp, were among those who had bought sizeable quantities of greenbacks.
The peso also dropped as coffee, oil and coal exporters brought few dollars into the market, dealers said.
They reported 385 trades for a total of $172 million and said the peso closed at its intraday low, well off its session high of 1,080.90 to the dollar.
